decisions.reason: This looks like a successful continuation and repositioning of an already accepted trommel screen, so a mature machinery maker would normally retain it.
A dedicated product page suggests real commercial commitment, and mobile shredding fits the firm's core recycling and waste-processing portfolio.
Although it was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, a mobile high-speed grinder is close to the firm's main application areas and would usually be given more time in the market.
A stationary electric fine shredder matches the firm's move toward tougher processing requirements and resource-saving solutions, making an early withdrawal unlikely.
Its green-waste focus is somewhat narrower and may overlap with other mobile grinder lines, but it still serves an important customer segment the firm already knows well.
A standalone presentation and strong fit with stationary pre-processing applications indicate this is a strategic portfolio addition that management would likely continue backing.
